# corpus: URLs whose userinfo carries a password
# expect: refused
# refs:   #5320
# shape:  scheme://user:<password>@host on a git remote, a push command, a database DSN and an sftp URL
# why:    a password in URL userinfo is a credential at any length, far below the 32-char run threshold
Mirror the repo with this remote:

    git remote add mirror https:/{{+}}/fixture-user:fixture-pw@git.example.com/example-org/project.git
    git push https:/{{+}}/oauth2:fixture-pw@gitlab.example.com/o/r.git main

The service reads postgres:/{{+}}/app:fixture-pw@127.0.0.1:5432/app and
uploads over sftp:/{{+}}/deploy:fixture-pw@files.example.com/drop.
